title: cmux feature
description: One cmux feature: schemas/features/features.d/<name>.json. scripts/cmux-next/gen-features.py validates every file against this schema and writes the Swift (CmuxNextFeatures) and Rust (cmux-features) registries. Modeled on Chromium's base/feature_list.h (BASE_FEATURE), base/metrics/field_trial_params.h (FeatureParam) and the flag expiry of chrome/browser/flag-metadata.json.

name.description: lowerCamelCase feature name; the file is features.d/<name>.json. The name is the wire key in flags.json, CMUX_ENABLE_FEATURES and CMUX_DISABLE_FEATURES.

owner.description: An owner from plans/cmux-next/OWNERS.md (an agent, a workstream or a person, as written in an Owner cell), or a PL-* workstream from plans/cmux-next/perf-lead.md. gen-features.py checks it.

description.description: One sentence: what turning the feature on changes for the person.

defaults.description: The channel default (the last step of the resolution order) per build channel.

kind.description: perfPath: a performance path that ships behind the feature until it is the default everywhere (needs an expiry and lab stories). killSwitch: a guard that a remote document can turn off. labs: a person-facing experiment on the Labs page.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD. After this day the feature is removed or made permanent. A perfPath feature expires at most 60 days after the day the generator runs.

process.description: Which process reads the feature. both: the app and the daemon, and the daemon keeps its own value for the session when they differ. chromium: a Chromium base::Feature passed to CEF through --enable-features/--disable-features (disable wins).

chromium_feature.description: The Chromium base::Feature name (for example BackForwardCache). Only with process chromium.

params.description: Typed parameters under the feature (Chromium's base::FeatureParam).

stories.description: Lab stories (scripts/perf-lab/stories.d/<id>.json) that bench both arms of the feature.

sticky.description: A remote off stays off in safe mode, even when the remote document is dropped.

runtimeMutable.description: The feature can change while the process runs. True only with teardownTest.

teardownTest.description: The test that proves the live teardown path, as Target.Suite/testName (Swift: a test method of type Suite in Tests/<Target>/) or crate::module::test (Rust: a #[test] fn in that module of the cmux-tui crate; tests/<file>.rs is crate::<file>).

benchOnly.description: Only DEBUG and bench (CMUX_BENCH_HOOKS) builds declare the feature: its handle and registry entry are compiled out of Release, Nightly and RC, so no shipped list, CLI or environment can name it. App features only.

replaces.description: Debug tunable keys and env switches this feature took over (gen-features.py --unmigrated stops listing them).

allOf.description: a perfPath feature needs an expiry and at least one lab story
a runtimeMutable feature needs the test of its live teardown path
chromium_feature goes with process chromium, and only there
a benchOnly feature is an app feature: only the app has bench builds

replaces.description: The numeric Debug tunable key this param took over (gen-features.py --unmigrated-params stops listing it).

allOf.description: a bool param has a boolean default and no range
an int param has an integer default and range
